chinese: 随着互联网的发展信息传播更快了
english: With the development of the Internet, information spreads faster.
soundmark: /wɪð ðə dɪˈveləpmənt əv ði ˈɪntərnet ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən spredz ˈfæstər/

chinese: 然而便利也伴随着新的问题
english: However, convenience also comes with new problems.
soundmark: /haʊˈevər kənˈviːniəns ˈɔːlsoʊ kʌmz wɪð nuː ˈprɑːbləmz/

chinese: 就我而言合理使用技术非常必要
english: As far as I am concerned, using technology properly is necessary.

chinese: 因此我们需要在效率和深度之间取得平衡
english: Therefore, we need to strike a balance between efficiency and depth.
soundmark: /ˈðerfɔːr wi niːd tə straɪk ə ˈbæləns bɪˈtwiːn ɪˈfɪʃənsi ænd depθ/

chinese: 只有这样我们才能真正受益
english: Only in this way can we truly benefit.
